releaseNotes:
• WhatsApp-style Contact Info: Shows only partner's profile with read-only name
• Full-Screen Avatar View: Tap avatar in top bar or profile sheet to view large photo with zoom
• WhatsApp View-Once Photos: Send 1-time view photos that auto-delete immediately after viewing
• Online / Offline with Last Seen timestamp (e.g., 'last seen today at 6:45 PM')
• Universal Deletion: Delete cards, audio songs, and file attachments for everyone
• Anti-Peep Tilt Shield Lock: 65° tilt latches black shield requiring Biometric/PIN to unlock
• WhatsApp-style Audio & Video Call History
